[[File:Stephanie AG034.png|thumb|250px|Stephanie]] '''Stephanie''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG034|Having a Wailord of a Time]]''. She was not given a name in the original Japanese version. Stephanie was going to select her first Pokémon from [[Nurse Joy]] in [[Slateport City]]. However, while {{Ash}} and [[Max]] were guarding the [[first partner Pokémon]], the {{p|Torchic}} became impatient and began running around the [[Pokémon Center]]. In its attempt to escape, it battled several of {{ashfr|the group}}'s Pokémon, which eventually caused Torchic to [[Evolution|evolve]] into a {{p|Combusken}}. Initially, Ash and Max tried to hide the Combusken and use [[May's Torchic]] as a diversion so it would seem like nothing had happened. However, their plan fell apart when {{an|May}} became suspicious of her Torchic's absence, and the Combusken busted out of its hiding place. {{TRT}} attempted to steal a {{p|Wailord}}, interrupting Stephanie's ability to choose a first partner Pokémon. Afterwards, Nurse Joy told Stephanie that Combusken would probably be a bad Pokémon for a beginning Trainer to use, so she chose {{p|Mudkip}}. [[Stephanie's father|Her father]] was drawn to the {{p|Treecko}}, which became his own first partner Pokémon, while Nurse Joy decided to keep Combusken with her at the Pokémon Center. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Stephanie |pkmn=Mudkip |type1=Water |img=Stephanie Mudkip.png |epnum=AG034 |epname=Having a Wailord of a Time |vajp=Megumi Hayashibara |vaen=Tara Jayne |desc=Stephanie's {{p|Mudkip}} was first looked after by {{Ash}} and [[Max]]. It appeared to be quite the crybaby and was often being soothed by [[Brock's Mudkip]]. In the end, it was picked by Stephanie as her [[first partner Pokémon]].
